warmUp.note: If you want: a short activity to start.
warmUp.prompt: Define success in one sentence, then refine it after your partner presents a counterexample.

ui.lessonGoal: Explore complexity, qualify claims and sustain discussion.
ui.levelTip: Choose 5–6 stations. Aim for nuance and qualification, and share the conversation fairly.

presentation.introduction: Grades. Expectations. Competition. Failure. The future. Who decides what success should look like? Explore the question together, one conversation at a time.
presentation.privacyNotice: You can use fictional examples. Nobody needs to share personal grades, family problems or private experiences.
quickStart: Give a reason or an example.
Ask your partner a follow-up question.
Open the challenge if you need more to discuss.
presentation.subtitle: A conversation, not a test
